title: Concern front matter
description: The front matter of a concern about a track's plan; the Markdown body is the argument and is never empty. A concern names its kind and, when it comes from one, the unit or the attempt of it. While it is open, no new unit of the track can be claimed.

kind.description: `wrong_assumption`: the plan assumes something the work contradicts. `better_idea`: a better way to test the track's idea. `blocker`: the plan cannot be carried out as written. `other`: anything else about the plan.

unit.description: The number of the unit of the track the concern comes from.

attempt.description: The sequence number of the attempt of that unit the concern comes from.
